reuse.why: All six link handlers now go through one linkBankAccount/linkExternalAccount path built on the existing findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, and the takeover reuses clearAccountLink, which unlinkAccount now also calls.

duplication.why: The five near-identical link bodies are collapsed into one, but downloadFintegraTransactions is still a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Link rules and guards sit in accounts/app.ts, download logic in sync.ts and the URL in server-config.ts, as the tree arranges them.

scope.why: It rewrites every existing link handler, which the requests did not ask for. The rewrite pays off, but it makes the diff much larger than the feature needs.

maintainability.why: Adding a provider becomes a few lines, the guards run once before any side effects, and the existing per-provider differences (fileId, notified tables, bank key) are explicit options.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers route through linkBankAccount; unlinkAccount and the takeover share clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining Fintegra download copy is a plain copy of the Akahu one, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked takes replaceExistingLink with one replace branch; the closed check is a separate guard; linkBankAccount's fileId/tables/bankKey options carry pre-existing per-provider variation, and no handler bypasses it.
